content.user_title: Analyze App Store Keywords with ASOScan
content.value_statement: Keyword rankings and demand trends can be difficult to compare across app markets. This skill uses ASOScan data to explain performance and prioritize relevant terms.
actual_capabilities: Retrieve tracked keywords with volume, difficulty, current rank, and rank movement for a selected country.
Read daily rank history for periods from 1 to 365 days.
Compare historical volume and difficulty using the metrics-history endpoint.
Research a specific new term, including competing app counts and top apps, after approval for the eight-credit call.
Classify keyword priorities using demand, difficulty, and current ranking.
Suggest up to three long-tail research alternatives for difficult terms, subject to approval for paid calls.
limitations: Requires connected ASOScan tools or shell access with an existing ASOSCAN_API_KEY and suitable API access.
Access is limited to apps in the account and tracked competitors; historical analysis depends on available records.
Each successful live research call costs eight credits, including repeated calls for the same term.
Volume represents relative demand within a market, not absolute search counts; recommendations cannot guarantee rankings.

use_cases.title: Prioritize Listing Keywords
use_cases.description: Compare tracked terms for one app and country, then prioritize relevant keywords with useful demand and manageable difficulty.

use_cases.title: Review Ranking Changes
use_cases.description: Review rank movement and daily history alongside volume and difficulty trends to identify keywords needing attention.

use_cases.title: Evaluate Client Keyword Ideas
use_cases.description: Research a specific proposed term and compare limited long-tail alternatives while keeping paid calls within an approved budget.

prompt_templates.title: Check a Tracked Keyword
prompt_templates.prompt: For [app] in [country], show the tracked keyword [term], its volume, difficulty, current rank, and seven-day rank movement.

prompt_templates.title: Review Rank History
prompt_templates.prompt: For [app] in [country], review 30 days of rank history for [term]. Explain changes and identify missing records without inventing values.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Keyword Priorities
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare tracked keywords for [app] in [country] using 30-day rank movement and 180-day metric trends. Group priorities and recommend three relevant actions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: compare ranking and demand trends.

prompt_templates.title: Research Budgeted Alternatives
prompt_templates.prompt: Research [term] for [app] in [country]. Request approval before each eight-credit call. Compare at most three long-tail alternatives and reuse earlier results.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: evaluate new terms with controlled spending.

output_examples.input: Illustrative data: habit tracker has volume 62, difficulty 28, rank 24, and seven-day rankDelta +6. Interpret it.
output: Habit tracker improved six positions to rank 24 over seven days.
Volume 62 indicates relative demand, not an absolute number of searches.
Compare difficulty 28 with relevant terms in the same country before deciding its priority.
Consider listing placement if the term accurately describes the app; ranking improvement is not guaranteed.

output_examples.input: I want live research for an untracked term, but I have not approved any credit spending.
output_examples.output: Live research costs eight credits per successful call, including repeat lookups. Do you approve one call for this term and country?

output_examples.input: Illustrative history: a keyword moved from rank 40 to 18 over 30 days, while volume stayed stable.
output: The keyword improved 22 positions over 30 days.
Stable volume suggests no recorded demand increase during the supplied period.
Review difficulty history before changing its priority. These observations do not establish what caused the ranking improvement.

best_practices: Select the correct account app and country before comparing metrics; compare relative demand within the same market.
Fetch tracked keywords once and reuse research results to avoid duplicate requests and unnecessary credit charges.
Approve expensive calls explicitly, keep the API key private, and preserve timestamps and missing values when interpreting trends.
anti_patterns: Treating relative volume as an absolute search count or promising a specific future rank.
Repeating paid research for the same term or researching alternatives without approval for each expensive call.
Guessing missing metrics, comparing unrelated markets, or treating an unranked value as rank zero.

faq.question: What connection does this skill need?
faq.answer: Use connected ASOScan tools, or shell access with an existing ASOSCAN_API_KEY and API access. Otherwise, the skill refers you to asoscan-setup.

faq.question: Which operations spend credits?
faq.answer: The skill documents tracked keyword and history reads as free. Successful live research costs eight credits per call and requires approval.

faq.question: Does a positive rankDelta mean improvement?
faq.answer: Yes. A positive rankDelta indicates movement toward position one over the selected window. A null rank means the keyword is not ranked.

faq.question: How much rank history can I request?
faq.answer: The documented rank-history endpoint accepts 1 to 365 days. Available results depend on the records ASOScan has collected.

faq.question: Does volume show an exact number of searches?
faq.answer: No. The skill describes volume as relative demand. Compare it within one market rather than treating it as an absolute search count.

faq.question: Can this skill discover many new keywords?
faq.answer: It focuses on tracked performance and specific new terms. Broad discovery is delegated to keyword-opportunities, while difficult terms can receive limited alternative research.
